name: xray
description: xray-spinners: two glanceable cards under the spinner, what Claude is doing and its to-do list, plus a session genome: every step, one colored cell

narration.title: xray: narration line
narration.description: A one-sentence » line from a small model (Haiku) at task start and on the first failure, at most once a minute, as the now card's last fact row. Off (default since round 21: terse facts over prose) = measured state only, no extra model calls.

customCards.title: xray: custom task cards
customCards.description: When the work has a measured property no ready-made card shows (git bisect, a benchmark loop, a batch with k/N progress, a long rerun build), a small model (Haiku) lays out the task card from the widget kit, once per such turn. Off = the kept default layouts only, no extra model calls.
